meta.title: Customer Value & Sustainability Review
meta.source: Lindström x Since AI synthetic data pack (100% synthetic/illustrative)

status_legend.SIMULATED: Taken directly from the synthetic data pack.
status_legend.ESTIMATED: Calculated or allocated from synthetic data using the stated formula and assumptions.
status_legend.TEAM_ASSUMPTION: Range or threshold chosen by our team; rationale listed under assumptions.
status_legend.PUBLIC_REFERENCE: Company-level figure provided by Lindström; not specific to this customer.
status_legend.FIELD_SCAN_DEMO: Captured live by the on-site gateway during the demo.

B_LOCAL.name: Outsourced local laundry
B_LOCAL.note: No systematic repair; textile waste assumed mixed waste. Values illustrative.

B_HOME.name: Home washing
B_HOME.note: 53% load-utilization concept; no centralized delivery; no systematic repair. Values illustrative.

B_INHOUSE.name: In-house customer laundry
B_INHOUSE.note: Customer-operated laundry scenario; no systematic repair. Values illustrative.

public_reference.claim: Lindström emissions intensity is about 13% lower than the textile-rental peer average.
public_reference.basis: Company emissions intensity, kg CO2e per EUR turnover (Angad, Discord, 7 Nov 2026).

assumptions.rule: Laundry waste allocated by customer share of washed kg
Rules use customer industry and stated priority
Comparison-baseline water and CO2e factors varied -20% / +20% for low / high.
Low / base / high = 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 replacements postponed per repair (pack default A002 = 1.0).
On-time green >= 98%, amber >= 95%. Scan-activity share green >= 85%, amber >= 75%.

assumptions.text: Allocated garments with no scan activity
assumptions.rule: allocated - scanned. An optimisation signal to investigate, not proof of idle garments.
Returned kg x laundry water/CO2e factor vs kg x baseline factor. Demo capture; real washed kg is measured at the laundry.
A package holds up to 25 garments of one product for one site; the package QR and the garment QRs inside it share the package id.
Not in the data pack. Demo dates derived from each package's first service date.

Repairs: garments repaired x synthetic purchase cost (replacement avoided). Write-offs: garments x purchase cost (replacement value). Cleaning and delivery prices are not in the data pack and are listed as a data gap.

industry_priorities.emphasis: Show service continuity, food-industry garment control and hygiene-related performance.
Prioritize water use/savings and washed-kg efficiency.
Highlight turnaround, service-request-free days and delivery performance.

adoption.unit: % of allocated garments with scan activity

sustainability.unit: L water saved vs local laundry

observations.text: NorthStar Västerås has the lowest scan-activity share (80.5%): about 153 allocated garments a month show no scan activity.
observations.question: Is the garment allocation at this site still right-sized, or are pickups being missed?

observations.text: NorthStar Pori has the lowest on-time rate (97.2%, 13 late cycles).
observations.question: Which delivery windows cause the late cycles, and should the route or schedule change?

observations.text: NorthStar Gothenburg has the highest repair intensity (1056 repairs). Repairs postponed an estimated 7,832-23,495 kg CO2e of new garments.
observations.question: Are the repairs concentrated in one product or task, and would a sturdier garment pay back?

observations.text: NorthStar Pori contributes the most water saved vs local laundry (~107,402 L).
observations.question: Should this water figure be used as Scope 3 / ESG evidence, and what audit trail is needed?
